cohort: The study participants were 46 patients who underwent cesarean hysterectomy for suspected or confirmed placenta accreta spectrum disorders (PASD) at a single Canadian tertiary care center.
finding: The study provided an institutional overview of placenta accreta spectrum disorders (PASD) management and outcomes, showing 94% confirmed PASD diagnoses, with specific rates for accreta, increta, and percreta, and documented associated morbidities and variations in practice like prophylactic ureteric stenting.
